audiomxd(1) General Commands Manual audiomxd(1)

NAME

audiomxd

SYNOPSIS

audiomxd

DESCRIPTION

audiomxd is a daemon that manages audio route arbitration on macOS along with other nearby Apple devices such as iPhones and iPads. audiomxd was introduced with macOS version 14.0.
